name: editics
description: Transforms Drupal content into Word/PDF documents via a template engine and a remote CRI conversion server.
project_description: The generation of desktop documents (PDF, DOCX) requires a lot of hard work on the part of the developer Drupal. Between the management of libraries and the whims of formatting, we find ourselves quickly lost and the possibilities for a rapid integration of a document generation solution is almost non-existent in Drupal. It is with this in mind that I would propose a module that, from a json flow and a docx model, quickly output a PDF/DOCX document.
